matching: Independent arm-blinded semantic judgment of cause, trigger, consequence and supporting evidence; path/rule overlap alone never establishes a true positive.
duplicates: One finding matches at most one defect; additional findings for that defect are false positives for precision.
uncertain: Pending; never a true positive. Unresolved judgments prevent quality acceptance.
quality_acceptance: Both point precision/recall differences and one-sided 95% lower bounds >= 0; no high/critical loss, incomplete coverage, invariant violation or unresolved judgment. Tiny, no-event and degenerate bootstrap samples are inconclusive.
performance: Separate workload/graph/cold-warm strata; all attempts and consumption retained. Speed claims require identical pair identities, complete validated required work, known accounting and representative sealed evidence.
pilot_limit: The existing 20 implementer-visible synthetic fixtures are a feasibility pilot, not a sealed holdout. Never tune, relabel or refreeze them in response to engine outputs.
